## TemplateEngine.\_processGShippingErrorBlocks() method

Block: g-shipping-error Extracts `<g-shipping-error>` plain-text blocks from a template string.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _processGShippingErrorBlocks(template: string): {
        [lang: string]: string;
    };
```

</td></tr>

**Returns:**

{ \[lang: string\]: string; }

An object mapping language keys to their raw text content

## Remarks

Children form only; content is cleaned exactly like `<g-message>` and keyed by `lang` (`"default"` when absent; last block wins per lang). Raw content is preserved verbatim (including `{{var|filter}}` spans) for later compilation. Plain-text rules are enforced by `validateBlockGShippingErrorAttributes`<!-- -->, not here.

## Example


```typescript
const blocks = TemplateEngine._processGShippingErrorBlocks(`<g-shipping-error>Di luar zona {{city}}</g-shipping-error>`);
// Result: { default: 'Di luar zona {{city}}' }
```
